title: Divisor Game
statement:
Alice and Bob take turns playing a game, with Alice starting first.
Initially, there is a number `n` on the chalkboard. On each player's turn, that player makes a move consisting of: choosing any `x` with `0 < x < n` and `n % x == 0`, and replacing the number `n` on the chalkboard with `n - x`.
Also, if a player cannot make a move, they lose the game.
Return `YES` if and only if Alice wins the game, assuming both players play optimally.

examples.explanation: Alice chooses x=1, n becomes 1. Bob has no move, Alice wins.
Alice must choose x=1, n becomes 2. Bob chooses x=1, n becomes 1. Alice loses.
